messages.body: Is the maize seed from this season's lot?
Yes, packed this season. Batch certificate is available at delivery.
Good, please proceed with the order.
Can you confirm the expected delivery date for the wheat seed?
It was dispatched yesterday and should arrive within two days.
Thank you. We will confirm once received.
Your dairy concentrate order is on the truck.
Understood. Please make sure the bags are sealed.
Can the DAP be delivered in two lots?
Yes, we can split it into 60 and 60 bags.
Please use the second lot for the field near the canal.
Noted, we will mention it in the delivery note.
Mangoes are being graded today. Crates will be packed tomorrow.
Great, we need them before Friday.
Could you include a purity certificate with the quotation?
Yes, it will be included with the delivery.
Please keep the quotation valid until next week.
Is a bulk discount possible for 100 bags?
The quoted rate already includes a bulk discount.
What is the warranty on the rotavator?
